Name: Once Upon a Fleurine - Custom NPC
Author: tottlesfarm
Description:
[center][/center][center][/center][center]﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/b6KN4n5.png[/img]

A new face joins Pelican Town—[b]Fleurine[/b], a whimsical and (not-so) mysterious witch from the [i]Magical Institute[/i]. With a flair for the dramatic and a heart full of good intentions, she’s here to keep a watchful eye on certain magical matters… though she’d much rather be enjoying a cup of tea or a lively gossip session. Charming, graceful, and full of surprises, Fleurine brings new friendships, heartfelt moments, and a touch of magic to the valley. Will you uncover the depths of her story, or simply bask in the glow of her dazzling presence?﻿﻿

Fleurine is [b]fully romanceable[/b], with multiple heart events and complete marriage dialogue! She attends almost every festival, but you won't find her at Spirit's Eve!

As of the [b]2.1.0[/b] update, Fleurine has the option for three separate Rival Hearts storylines: Haley, Shane, and Elliott.

To see details on Fleurine's [b]Gift Tastes[/b], [b]Schedules[/b], and [b]Heart Events[/b], see the Articles section![/center][center]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zQCJPB0.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]﻿[/center][b]CREDITS[/b]
[list]
[*]Fleurine's [i]stunning[/i] sprites and portraits were done by [b][url=https://leviaticart.wixsite.com/leviatic/pixel-art]Leviatic[/url]﻿[/b]. She brought Fleurine to life, and this project wouldn't have been possible without her.
[*]Fleurine's Tower, as pink and bubbly as the magical girl herself, was done by [b][url=https://ko-fi.com/suzukipc/commissions]Pau[/url]﻿[/b]. I gave inspiration photos and was given a work of art in return!
[*]Fleurine's interior maps were made by myself and my wife, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sapphicsaph]Saph[/url]﻿, using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27454]Luny's Wizard Furniture Recolor[/url]﻿!
[*]New [b]Nyapu[/b] style portraits done by [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/lilachilling]lilachilling[/url]﻿[/b], who was kind enough to send me the files to include in Fleurine's files! This is her second Nyapu stylization, the first you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34459]here[/url]﻿!
[*]New SVE patch coded by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Solariaze/mods]Solariaze[/url]﻿, I simply added it in an tweaked it to fit for my purposes.
[/list]
[b]COMPATIBILITY
[/b]So far, Fleurine has compatibility with:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17309]Casper And The Box[/url]: Fleurine has responding Conversation Topics to Casper's shenanigans.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]: Fleurine has Sunberry schedules and responding Conversation Topics, as well as several of the add ons!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20099]Pride in the Valley[/url]﻿: Fleurine attends the Pride festival and has responding Conversation Topics.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿: Fleurine has Ridgeside schedules and responding Conversation Topics.
[*]Cornucopia: Fleurine has responding gift tastes to the items in the Cornucopia mods by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods?gameId=1303]MizuJakkaru[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]﻿: Fleurine has responding gift tastes to the items in the WAG mod.
[*]Female Wizard Mods: Fleurine has a config for female wizard mods, so she uses the correct pronouns when referring to the witch.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿: When SVE is installed, she has an automatic map patch that should apply to ensure for a seamless transition from one to the other. Her SVE patch will only work if you have the "Shorter path to Blue Moon Vineyard" option toggled off.
[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Foragers Nooks and Crannies[/b]: One of the warps cuts off part of Fleurine's tower. This is a purely cosmetic issue and won't affect gameplay at all.
[*]If you have [b]Fleurine & Elliott[/b] toggled on, there's a small error with nullifying Elliott's romance events. It's a single line of red text, but it shouldn't affect gameplay at all. If this causes any problems, let me know!
[*][b]Abandoned Bride[/b]: There is some overlap of these maps, making the mods incompatible. I will not be prioritizing making Fleurine compatible with Abandoned Bride, as it hasn't been updated for 1.6 and appears to be abandoned. 
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]: Her SVE patch will only work if you have the "Shorter path to Blue Moon Vineyard" option toggled [b]off[/b].
[/list]
[b]F.A.Q.[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Where is Fleurine's Tower?[/b]:  Fleurine's Tower is in Cindersap Forest, on the East side of the map.
[*][b]Is Fleurine compatible with SVE?[/b]:  Yes, mostly! When SVE is installed, she has an automatic map patch that should apply to ensure for a seamless transition from one to the other.
[*][b]Is Fleurine compatible with...?[/b]:  Probably! Her tower is pretty out of the way and her schedules don't interfere with maps or other NPCs, so she should fit right in with other NPCs or expansions just fine! If you find an issue, let me know!
[*][b]Why doesn't Fleurine attend the Spirit's Eve festival?:  [/b]Fleurine is a little spooked by the spirits and prefers to respect them by staying far the heck away from anything that might offend them!
[*][b]Will she work with an existing save?:  [/b]Yes, so long as you reset terrain features on the forest map.
[*][b]Help, Fleurine is...[/b]:  Provide me with a log! If I don't have a log, I can't help you!
[*][b]Can I upload a translation?:  [/b]Yes, as long as you translate it yourself. Please do not put any parts of my mod into AI, especially to translate. Some of Fleurine's lines include "made up" words and bits of flair that require a human touch that AI wouldn't be able to grasp. If you do make a translation, feel free to publish it and include this mod as a dependency. 
[*][b]Will you readd the Realm option?[/b]: Probably not. I was unhappy with the map and maintaining it was proving difficult with her scheduling and event planning.
[/list]
[b]COMING SOON
[/b][list]
[*]A custom wedding ceremony.
[*]More mini-events with the townies.
[*]Added rooms to her tower.
[*]Magical Institute content.
[*]A mini-event regarding her aversion to Spirit's Eve.
[*]Crossover event content with a handful of NPCs such as Eli & Dylan and Casper And The Box.
[/list]
[b]MODS USED IN SCREENSHOTS[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral[/url]﻿
[*]Magical Valley [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26211]UI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25370]Cursors[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage﻿[/url]﻿
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Make sure to delete the old file before extracting into your mods folder! This update adds a lot of content, including renamed events and rival hearts. I recommend starting a new save, or you may see repeats of Fleurine's events.
